# World-Class Generated UI/UX Plan

**Status:** Proposed
**Author:** Datacraft — Nyimbi Odero (with Claude)
**Date:** 2026-07-04
**Scope:** The UI/UX of applications *generated by the APG compiler* (`compiler/code_generator.py` + `compiler/templates/`), not the Studio/marketplace UI (covered briefly in §11).

---

## 1. Executive Summary — Honest Assessment

**Is the generated UI world class today? No.** It is a strong B-/B foundation with several genuinely good pieces, but it fails the "world class" bar on eight fronts.

### What is already good

| Feature | Where |
|---|---|
| Tailwind-styled shell, cards, badges, stat rows | `_html_page()` code_generator.py:3636, `theme_stylesheet()`:3526 |
| htmx inline field editing with optimistic-concurrency (`expected_revision`) | :4941–5155 |
| Kanban board with SortableJS drag-and-drop + toast feedback | `kanban_view.html.j2` |
| Command palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K) with debounced search | embedded JS, :456 |
| Semantic field rendering (email/phone/url/currency/percent/rating/status/color/json/boolean) | `widgets/field_display.html.j2`, `_ui_field_semantic()`:4464 |
| Sort/paginate/search on entity lists, bulk select + CSV export | `_ui_records_table_html()`:4643 |
| Multi-step workflow wizard with progress indicator | `_ui_workflow_wizard_html()`:4109 |
| OS dark mode, per-capability theme tokens in `/theme.css` | :3560, :3542 |
| Activity timeline + notes on record detail | `record_detail.html.j2` |

### Why it is not world class

1. **CDN dependency** — Tailwind Play CDN, unpkg htmx, jsDelivr SortableJS on every page (:3636–3643). Generated apps break offline and violate our locally-hosted/open-source technology strategy. The Tailwind *Play* CDN is also explicitly not for production (runtime JIT in the browser, FOUC, ~100ms style flash).
2. **Two-tier page quality** — 6 pages (workflow list/wizard, database catalog, agent console, capability console, flow debugger) are f-string-only with no template: raw `<pre>` JSON dumps, unstyled forms. The agent console — the most differentiating APG feature — looks like a debug tool.
3. **Zero data visualization** — no charts, sparklines, or trends anywhere. Stat cards show raw counts. An "enterprise ERP platform" example (20) renders no dashboard.
4. **No authentication UI** — backend supports JWT bearer (:1992–2013) but there is no login page, session, profile, logout, or permission-gated navigation.
5. **No real-time UI** — Bytewax streaming and agents are modeled in the DSL, but the UI has no SSE/WebSocket consumer, no live dashboards, no streaming agent responses.
6. **i18n dead-ends** — the DSL carries `i18n.supported_languages` (example 10 lists 30+ languages incl. African languages) but `lang="en"` is hardcoded (:3683); no switcher, no locale formatting, no RTL.
7. **Mobile is an afterthought** — no hamburger nav, sidebar create-form forces long scrolls on phones, kanban has no stacked mobile view, no PWA manifest/offline.
8. **Accessibility gaps** — no skip-to-content link, `aria-current` absent on nav, no focus management on tab switches, native `window.confirm()` for destructive actions, color-only status distinctions in places.

### North star

> Every app generated by `apg compile` should look and feel like a polished commercial SaaS product on first run — self-contained (zero network dependencies), fast, accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA), beautiful in light and dark, responsive from phone to ultrawide, and alive (streaming agents, live dashboards) — with zero configuration required and every pixel overridable via theme tokens.

---

## 2. Design Principles

1. **Self-contained by default.** A generated app must run air-gapped. All CSS/JS/fonts/icons are compile-time-vendored static assets. No CDN, ever. (Aligns with the Ollama-local company strategy.)
2. **The DSL is the design brief.** Everything the author declared — entity semantics, relationships, workflows, agents, themes, i18n — must *visibly* improve the UI. Modeled-but-invisible features are bugs.
3. **One rendering path.** Jinja2 templates are the only first-class path. The f-string fallback is reduced to a single minimal "Jinja2 missing" error page, not a parallel UI.
4. **Progressive enhancement.** Server-rendered HTML works without JS; htmx + small vanilla modules add interactivity. No SPA framework — keeps generated apps auditable and dependency-light.
5. **Accessible is not optional.** WCAG 2.1 AA is a compile gate, not a cleanup task.
6. **Delight through defaults.** Empty states teach, destructive actions are undoable, forms validate inline, tables remember your view. The experienced practitioner should feel the app anticipated them.
7. **Every visual change regenerates the baselines.** The 20 golden examples (`compiler/baseline.py:678` string-equality gate) are regenerated and committed with each UI phase — they double as visual regression corpus.

---

## 3. Architecture Decisions (foundational, decide once)

### AD-1: Kill the CDNs — compile-time static asset pipeline

**Decision:** The compiler ships vendored, pinned, minified assets and emits them into the generated output as a `static/` directory (served by Flask's static route). `app.py` stops embedding CSS/JS as string literals beyond a tiny bootstrap.

```
compiler/assets/                      # checked into the APG repo, pinned versions
├── apg.css                           # precompiled utility+component stylesheet (see AD-2)
├── htmx.min.js                       # htmx 2.0.x, vendored
├── sortable.min.js                   # SortableJS 1.15.x, vendored
├── uplot.min.js + uplot.min.css      # charts (see AD-3)
├── apg-ui.js                         # our component runtime (toasts, palette, tabs, combobox…)
├── fonts/                            # Inter var + Noto Sans (subset, woff2), self-hosted
└── icons.svg                         # single SVG sprite (Lucide subset, ~120 icons)

examples/NN_*/output/
├── app.py
├── static/…                          # copied verbatim at compile time
└── requirements.txt
```

Generated pages reference `/static/apg.css` etc. Rationale: offline-first, no FOUC, immutable-cacheable, and `app.py` stays reviewable. **Note:** `PythonCodeGenerator.generate()` returns `dict[path, content]` — binary-ish assets (woff2) need either base64-embedding in the dict with a writer that decodes, or extending the generator result type to support bytes. Prefer extending to `dict[str, str | bytes]` (small compiler change, verify all writers + baseline comparison handle bytes).

### AD-2: Replace Tailwind Play CDN with a compiled design-token stylesheet

The template set is closed at compiler-build time, so the utility classes used are enumerable. Two options:

- **Option A (recommended):** Run the Tailwind standalone CLI *once in the APG repo* (dev-time, not user-time) over `compiler/templates/**` + `apg-ui.js` to produce a pinned `compiler/assets/apg.css` (~30–50 KB). Check the output in; add a CI check that regenerates and diffs it. Generated apps never run Tailwind.
- **Option B:** Hand-rolled custom-property design system (drop utilities entirely). Cleaner long-term but a large rewrite of all templates.

Go with **A**, layered as: `@layer tokens` (CSS custom properties — colors, spacing, radius, shadows, typography scale, motion durations) → `@layer components` (`.apg-*` classes) → `@layer utilities` (Tailwind subset). All colors flow through custom properties so runtime theming (`/theme.css`) keeps working and per-capability tokens override cleanly.

**Design tokens (formalize what `theme_stylesheet()` started):**

- Color: full 11-step ramps for primary/accent/neutral + semantic (success/warning/danger/info), auto-derived dark variants; APG default palette stays teal `#1E5B5A` / amber `#D97706`.
- Typography: Inter var (UI) + tabular-nums for data; scale 12/13/14/16/18/24/30; self-hosted subset woff2.
- Spacing: 4px grid. Radius: 6/8/12. Elevation: 3 shadow levels. Motion: 120/200/300ms + `prefers-reduced-motion` guard.

### AD-3: Charting library — uPlot (vendored) + declarative chart spec

**Decision:** uPlot (~48 KB min, MIT) for time-series/line/bar/area, plus a tiny in-house SVG renderer inside `apg-ui.js` for donut/progress/sparkline. Rejected: ECharts (~1 MB — too heavy to vendor into every app), Chart.js (~200 KB, canvas-only a11y story weaker), D3 (framework, not a chart lib). Charts are declared server-side as JSON specs in a `<script type="application/json">` island; `apg-ui.js` hydrates them. Every chart gets an accessible table fallback (`<details>` with the underlying data).

### AD-4: Interactivity stack stays htmx + vanilla modules

No React/Vue in generated apps. `apg-ui.js` is a namespaced module registry (`data-apg="combobox"` attributes → progressive enhancement), covering: toast, command palette, tabs, combobox/autocomplete, modal/drawer (focus-trapped), dropdown menu, date picker (native + polish), undo snackbar, chart hydrator, SSE subscriber, theme toggle, table column manager. Budget: ≤ 24 KB min+gzip.

### AD-5: Real-time via SSE, not WebSockets

Generated apps are single-process Flask; SSE (`text/event-stream`) works with no extra dependency, proxies cleanly, auto-reconnects. Use for: agent token streaming (Ollama streams natively), workflow run progress, dashboard live tiles, activity feeds. WebSockets deferred until a genuine bidirectional need exists.

### AD-6: One rendering path

Every page gets a `.j2` template in `APG_UI_TEMPLATES`. The f-string fallback (`_render_template()` returning `None` → :4327 pattern) collapses to a single static "This application requires Jinja2 (`pip install -r requirements.txt`)" page. Jinja2 is already in generated `requirements.txt`; maintaining a parallel unstyled UI doubles maintenance and guarantees drift. Delete the per-page f-string builders after template parity is proven (tests assert every route renders via template).

## 4. Phase 0 — Foundation (asset pipeline + design system + template unification)

*Everything else builds on this. Highest priority.*

### 4.1 Asset pipeline
- [ ] Create `compiler/assets/` with pinned, vendored htmx 2.0.x, SortableJS 1.15.x, uPlot, Inter/Noto woff2 subsets, Lucide SVG sprite (subset), LICENSE files for each.
- [ ] Tailwind standalone CLI build script (`scripts/build_apg_css.sh`) → `compiler/assets/apg.css`; CI job diffs regenerated output (stale-asset gate, mirrors the baseline philosophy).
- [ ] Extend `PythonCodeGenerator.generate()` to emit `static/**` files; update CLI writer, `baseline.py` comparison (`:654`, `:678`) to cover them (bytes-safe compare).
- [ ] `_html_page()` (:3636) drops all CDN `<link>`/`<script>` tags → `/static/*` references with content-hash query strings for cache busting.
- [ ] `requirements.txt` for generated apps stays: Flask + Jinja2 (+ nothing new).

### 4.2 Design system
- [ ] Token layer as in AD-2; rewrite `theme_stylesheet()` (:3526) to emit *only* tokens + per-capability overrides (component CSS moves into `apg.css`).
- [ ] In-app theme toggle (light/dark/system) persisted in `localStorage`, honoring `prefers-color-scheme` as default; `data-theme` attribute on `<html>`; every component styled in both modes.
- [ ] Iconography: replace emoji glyphs (⚡📋🔗🔌) with the SVG sprite; consistent 16/20px sizes, `aria-hidden` + text labels.

### 4.3 App shell v2
- [ ] Responsive shell: topbar (product name, command palette trigger, theme toggle, user slot) + collapsible left sidebar (entity nav grouped by capability, workflows, agents, dashboards) with `aria-current`, keyboard navigable, hamburger at < 768px, persisted collapse state.
- [ ] Breadcrumbs on every non-index page; skip-to-content link; consistent page header pattern (title, description, primary action).
- [ ] Command palette v2: sections (entities, records, actions, navigation), recent items, keyboard-only flow, ⌘K/CTRL-K + `/` shortcut.

### 4.4 Template unification (kill the f-string tier)
New `.j2` templates for the six template-less pages:
- [ ] `workflow_list.html.j2` — card grid of workflows with entity, step count, run history summary.
- [ ] `workflow_wizard.html.j2` — stepper component (numbered, checkmarked completed steps), field validation display, review-before-submit final step.
- [ ] `database_catalog.html.j2` — schema browser: tables, columns, types, relationship diagram (SVG).
- [ ] `agent_console.html.j2` — see Phase 3 (do the structural template now, streaming later).
- [ ] `capability_console.html.j2` — rules/config/approval panels as proper forms with result cards, not JSON dumps.
- [ ] `debug_console.html.j2` — flow debugger with timeline visualization of runs.
- [ ] Delete per-page f-string builders; single fallback error page; tests assert every `/ui/*` route renders from `APG_UI_TEMPLATES`.

### 4.5 Baseline & tests for Phase 0
- [ ] Regenerate all 20 example outputs; commit.
- [ ] New tests: `tests/test_generated_ui_assets.py` (static files present, no `http(s)://` external refs in any generated HTML — *the offline gate*), `tests/test_generated_ui_templates.py` (route→template coverage).

**Exit criteria:** zero external network requests in any generated app (assert by grepping generated output for `cdn.`, `unpkg`, `jsdelivr`, `googleapis`); all pages template-rendered; dark/light toggle works; Lighthouse Performance ≥ 90 on example 20.

## 5. Phase 1 — Data Experience (tables, forms, records: the daily-driver surfaces)

### 5.1 Tables v2 (`entity_list.html.j2`, `_ui_records_table_html()`:4643)
- [ ] Remove the hardcoded 6-column cap (:4650) → column manager (show/hide/reorder, persisted per-entity in `localStorage`).
- [ ] Per-column filter row driven by semantic type: text contains, number range, date range, boolean tri-state, FK select, status multi-select.
- [ ] Multi-sort (shift-click), sticky header, density toggle (comfortable/compact), row count + "jump to page", keyboard row navigation (↑/↓/Enter).
- [ ] Saved views: named filter+sort+column presets (server-side per entity, listed as tabs above the table).
- [ ] Bulk actions v2: bulk edit (set field across selection), bulk status change, bulk delete **with undo** (soft-delete window + snackbar, replaces `window.confirm`).
- [ ] Inline row expansion (chevron → related records preview without navigation).
- [ ] Export: CSV (existing) + XLSX-compatible CSV with UTF-8 BOM; respect active filters.

### 5.2 Forms v2 (`_ui_create_form_html()`:4632, editor inputs :4549)
- [ ] Move create form from squeezed sidebar to a **drawer/modal** (focus-trapped) — fixes the mobile long-scroll problem and gives forms room.
- [ ] Inline field-level validation: client-side (type, required, range from DSL constraints) rendered under the field, plus server errors mapped back to fields — no more single banner.
- [ ] Semantic inputs: FK **combobox with typeahead** (replaces plain `<select>`, critical for >50 rows), currency input with locale formatting, phone input with country hint, color picker for `color` fields, star-rating input for `rating`, tags input for list fields, textarea autogrow, native date/datetime with formatted display.
- [ ] File/image upload for `image_url`-semantic fields (local `static/uploads/`, preview thumbnail).
- [ ] Unsaved-changes guard, ⌘S/Ctrl-S to submit, autofocus first field, logical tab order.

### 5.3 Record detail v2 (`record_detail.html.j2`)
- [ ] Header: title from best display field, status badge, primary actions (Edit, Delete-with-undo, entity-specific workflow triggers).
- [ ] Related records: inline add ("attach existing / create new"), counts on tab labels.
- [ ] Activity timeline v2: field-change diffs ("status: open → closed"), note threading, relative timestamps with absolute on hover.
- [ ] Prev/next record navigation (J/K), copy-link button, print stylesheet.

### 5.4 Empty, loading, error states — everywhere
- [ ] Empty-state component: SVG illustration + one-line explanation + primary CTA ("No customers yet — Create your first customer"), used on every list/related/activity/dashboard surface.
- [ ] Skeleton loading (extend the existing shimmer :3664) on htmx swaps and slow tables.
- [ ] Friendly 404/500 pages in the shell (currently default Flask white pages).

**Exit criteria:** an experienced operator can run a full day's CRUD workload without touching the URL bar or hitting a dead end; forms never lose data; deletes are recoverable for 10s; regenerated baselines committed.

## 6. Phase 2 — Dashboards & Data Visualization

*This is where "generated app" becomes "product". APG knows the schema, semantics, and relationships — it can generate genuinely useful dashboards no hand-rolled Flask app gets for free.*

- [ ] **Auto-generated home dashboard** (replaces the static stat row in `app_index.html.j2`): per-entity record counts **with 30-day sparkline + delta** (from created-at timestamps), status-field donut charts (any entity with a `status` semantic), recent-activity feed, workflow-run summary tile, agent-invocation tile.
- [ ] **Per-entity analytics tab**: records-over-time line, group-by-status/category bars, numeric-field distributions, FK top-N ("orders by customer") — all inferred from semantics + relationships, zero config.
- [ ] **DSL `dashboard` block** (additive syntax) for authors who want control:
  ```apg
  dashboard SalesOverview {
    tile revenue: sum(Order.total) over month as line;
    tile pipeline: count(Deal) group_by stage as funnel;
    tile top_customers: top(Customer, by: count(Order), 10) as table;
  }
  ```
  Compiler validates fields exist and types are aggregable; emits chart-spec JSON.
- [ ] Chart components (uPlot + SVG mini-renderer per AD-3): line/area/bar/sparkline/donut/progress/funnel/stat-delta; theme-token colors; dark-mode aware; accessible data-table fallback under every chart; empty and error states.
- [ ] Dashboard tiles are SSE-refreshable (hooks for Phase 3).

**Exit criteria:** example 18 (`operations_dashboard_capability`) and 20 (`enterprise_erp_platform`) open onto dashboards that would look at home in a commercial BI tool; charts render offline; axe reports 0 critical on dashboard pages.

---

## 7. Phase 3 — Live UI: Agents, Workflows, Streaming

*The agent console is APG's most differentiating surface and currently its ugliest.*

### 7.1 Agent & team console v2 (`_ui_agent_console_html()`:5411)
- [ ] Chat-style conversation UI: message bubbles, role avatars, markdown rendering (vendored, sanitized micro-renderer — no raw HTML injection), code blocks with copy button.
- [ ] **Token streaming via SSE** from Ollama (`stream=true` passthrough): typing indicator, incremental render, stop-generation button, retry.
- [ ] Structured I/O panel: collapsible "request/response JSON" for practitioners (keep the power, hide it by default).
- [ ] Team console: per-member lanes showing which agent is acting, hand-off visualization, per-step timing.
- [ ] Conversation history persisted (session store), clear/export controls.

### 7.2 Workflow experience
- [ ] Workflow run progress via SSE: stepper updates live, per-step status (pending/running/succeeded/failed) with durations.
- [ ] Run history table per workflow with outcome badges and drill-in to the flow debugger view.
- [ ] Human-task inbox pattern: "Waiting on you" tile on the dashboard listing pending wizard steps.

### 7.3 Live data
- [ ] `/events` SSE endpoint multiplexing topics (`entity:Customer`, `workflow:run:ID`, `agent:NAME`); `apg-ui.js` subscriber with auto-reconnect + backoff; heartbeat comments to keep proxies open.
- [ ] Entity tables/dashboards subscribe → new-rows pill ("3 new records — refresh"), live tile updates. No full-page reloads.
- [ ] Notification center: bell in topbar, unread count, feed of workflow completions/agent results/notes.

**Exit criteria:** invoking an agent feels like a first-class AI product (streamed, interruptible, readable), not a curl-in-a-webpage; a workflow run can be watched live end-to-end.

## 8. Phase 4 — Authentication & Authorization UX

*Backend JWT support exists (:1992–2013); it needs a face. Keep it optional — apps without auth declared stay open.*

- [ ] Login page: centered card, product name/logo from theme, username/password (against the generated app's user store) or token paste mode when JWT-only; error states; reduced-motion-safe.
- [ ] Session UX: user menu in topbar (name, avatar initials, theme toggle, logout), session-expiry toast with re-auth modal that preserves in-flight form data.
- [ ] Permission-aware UI: nav items, action buttons, and columns hidden/disabled per role claims; friendly 403 page ("Ask your admin for the `orders:write` role").
- [ ] DSL surface: `auth { mode: jwt | session; roles: [...] }` block flows to generated login + gating.
- [ ] First-run experience: when auth is enabled and no users exist → guided "create admin account" screen.

**Exit criteria:** an auth-enabled example app demonstrates login → role-gated nav → logout with zero configuration beyond the DSL block.

## 9. Phase 5 — Internationalization & Theming Depth

### 9.1 i18n (make example 10's declarations real)
- [ ] Locale bundle generation: compiler emits `static/i18n/<lang>.json` for all UI chrome strings; entity/field labels translatable via DSL `i18n` maps; `lang` attribute set from active locale (fix hardcoded `lang="en"` :3683).
- [ ] Language switcher in topbar (persisted, `Accept-Language` default); locale-aware number/currency/date formatting via `Intl` (currency semantic finally gets symbols).
- [ ] RTL: `dir="rtl"` for Arabic-script locales; logical CSS properties (`margin-inline-start`…) throughout `apg.css`; mirrored icons where directional.
- [ ] African-language priority: seed translations for the EASF/NLLB-relevant set declared in examples (sw, am, ha, yo, om, so…) — chrome strings machine-translated via local NLLB/Ollama then human-reviewable files.

### 9.2 Theming depth
- [ ] Full token override from DSL `theme` block: palette ramps, fonts (from vendored set), radius, density, logo asset.
- [ ] The 4 landing variants (`default|minimal|corporate|africa`) become **complete app-wide themes** (today they only change the hero gradient).
- [ ] Theme preview page (`/ui/theme`) rendering every component in both modes — doubles as the visual-regression target.

**Exit criteria:** example 10 compiles into a genuinely multilingual app; switching to Swahili or Arabic produces a correctly formatted, correctly mirrored UI.

## 10. Phase 6 — Mobile & PWA

- [ ] Mobile navigation: hamburger → slide-in drawer (focus-trapped); bottom action bar for primary actions on phones; 44px minimum touch targets.
- [ ] Kanban mobile: stacked columns with horizontal swipe + column picker; long-press drag.
- [ ] Tables on phones: priority-column view with per-row expand (never horizontal-scroll misery).
- [ ] PWA: manifest (name/theme-color/icons generated from theme), service worker with static-asset cache + read-only offline for recently viewed pages, offline banner, mutation queue-and-retry deferred to a later iteration (out of scope here).
- [ ] Meta polish: theme-color, apple-touch-icon, generated favicon from theme initial/logo.

**Exit criteria:** Lighthouse PWA installable; example 20 fully operable on a 375px viewport without horizontal scroll.

## 11. Phase 7 — Quality Gates & Studio Parity

### 11.1 Automated UX quality gates (CI)
- [ ] **Playwright visual regression** (`tests/ui/`): compile 3 representative examples (01, 10, 20), boot each app, screenshot every route in light+dark at 375/768/1440px widths; compare against committed goldens (this *extends* the existing string-equality baseline into rendered-pixel space).
- [ ] **Accessibility gate:** axe-core via Playwright on every route — 0 critical/serious violations to pass CI.
- [ ] **Performance budget:** Lighthouse CI on example 20 — Performance ≥ 95, total JS ≤ 120 KB gzip, CSS ≤ 60 KB gzip, zero external requests.
- [ ] **Offline gate:** boot an example with network namespace blocked; crawl all routes; assert 200s and no console errors.
- [ ] Keyboard-only smoke test: palette → navigate → create record → edit field → delete+undo, no mouse.

### 11.2 Baseline workflow tooling
- [ ] `apg baseline --refresh` convenience (wraps `refresh_outputs=True` for all 20 examples) so UI iterations are one command; document in `docs/` that **every template/CSS/JS change requires it**.
- [ ] Pre-commit check: if `compiler/templates/**` or `compiler/assets/**` changed and `examples/*/output` didn't, fail with instructions.

### 11.3 Studio & marketplace parity (brief)
- [ ] Apply the same token system + vendored assets to `landing.html.j2`, `marketplace.html.j2`, and `compiler/studio.py` so the toolchain's own UI matches what it generates. (Separate, smaller effort; do after Phase 2.)

## 12. Component Library (target inventory in `apg.css` + `apg-ui.js`)

Layout: shell, sidebar, topbar, page-header, breadcrumbs, grid, card, drawer, modal, tabs, accordion.
Data: table (v2), column manager, filter row, saved-view tabs, pagination, kanban, timeline, stat tile, sparkline, line/area/bar/donut/funnel chart, progress, badge, avatar, empty state, skeleton.
Forms: input, select, combobox/typeahead, checkbox, radio, switch, date picker, currency input, phone input, rating input, tags input, color picker, file upload, field-error, form-section, wizard stepper.
Feedback: toast, undo snackbar, banner/alert, notification center, confirm dialog (accessible replacement for `window.confirm`), tooltip, spinner.
Navigation: command palette, dropdown menu, user menu, language switcher, theme toggle.
Agent/live: chat bubble, streaming cursor, markdown block, code block w/ copy, SSE status pill, run stepper.

Every component: light+dark, RTL-safe, keyboard-operable, `prefers-reduced-motion`-aware, documented on the `/ui/theme` preview page.

## 13. Sequencing, Effort, Dependencies

| Phase | Content | Est. effort | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Assets, tokens, shell, template unification | 2–3 wks | — |
| 1 | Tables/forms/records/states | 2–3 wks | 0 |
| 2 | Dashboards & charts | 2 wks | 0 (1 helpful) |
| 3 | Agents/workflows/SSE | 2 wks | 0 |
| 4 | Auth UX | 1 wk | 0 |
| 5 | i18n & theming | 1.5–2 wks | 0 |
| 6 | Mobile & PWA | 1–1.5 wks | 0–1 |
| 7 | Quality gates + Studio parity | 1–1.5 wks | starts alongside 0, gates all |

Phases 2/3/4 are parallelizable after Phase 0. **Phase 7's Playwright+axe harness should be stood up during Phase 0** so every subsequent phase lands against the gates, not before them. Each phase ends with: regenerate 20 baselines → full `uv run pytest tests/ -q` → commit → push (per the standing production-readiness mandate).

## 14. Success Metrics (definition of "world class")

1. **Zero** external network requests from any generated app (automated gate).
2. Lighthouse on example 20: Performance ≥ 95, Accessibility ≥ 95, Best Practices ≥ 95, PWA installable.
3. axe-core: 0 critical/serious violations on every generated route.
4. WCAG 2.1 AA: keyboard-only completion of all CRUD + agent flows.
5. Every DSL feature (semantics, themes, i18n, agents, workflows, streaming) has a visible, polished UI manifestation — no modeled-but-invisible features.
6. First-render < 1s and interactive < 1.5s on localhost mid-tier hardware; JS ≤ 120 KB gzip.
7. Visual regression suite green across 3 examples × all routes × 2 themes × 3 viewports.
8. The subjective bar: a screenshot of example 20's dashboard is indistinguishable in polish from a contemporary commercial SaaS product.

## 15. Risks & Mitigations

| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Baseline churn: every UI commit rewrites 20 outputs, bloating diffs | `apg baseline --refresh` + pre-commit gate (§11.2); batch UI changes per phase; outputs are generated artifacts — reviewers review templates, not outputs |
| `generate()` returning `str`-only blocks binary assets | Extend to `str \| bytes` early in Phase 0; audit all writers + baseline compare |
| Asset bloat in every example output dir | Assets ~150–250 KB total; acceptable. If not: single shared `examples/_assets/` with generator emitting relative refs (weigh against self-containment) |
| f-string deletion breaks a consumer relying on Jinja2-less operation | Search tests/docs for that assumption first; Jinja2 is already in generated requirements.txt, so the no-Jinja2 path is already off-contract |
| Tailwind CLI build drift between devs | Pinned CLI version in the build script + CI stale-check (§4.1) |
| Scope creep toward SPA | AD-4 is a hard line: htmx + vanilla modules, 24 KB JS budget enforced by the perf gate |

## 16. Immediate Next Steps

1. Approve architecture decisions AD-1…AD-6 (esp. CDN removal + uPlot choice).
2. Phase 0 branch: vendored assets + `static/` emission + CSS build script.
3. Stand up the Playwright/axe/Lighthouse harness (Phase 7 early-start) against the *current* UI to capture the "before" corpus.
4. Regenerate baselines; commit; push.
